杨童英姿飒爽的到了胡九郎身边。

胡九郎还没开口说话，汐汐开口道：

“什么情况？胡先生，需要帮助吗？”

这个汐汐可真的是个热心肠，胡九郎微微一笑。

“姐，没事，你先回去吧，我这是另有生意了！”

汐汐这才放心，但是还是忍不住说道：

“请先生也不必是这个语气吧？不应该客客气气的吗？”

汐汐说着走出巷子，上了自己的车，绝尘而去。

胡九郎苦笑一声。

“杨小姐，我是无辜的，为什么要跟你走一趟呀？我承认自己是贪了点，但是莫奇卫犯的事，我是真的不知道！”

杨童不置可否，就要拉胡九郎的手腕，胡九郎也是往后退了一步，这时一个年轻小伙冲了过来，站在杨童和胡九郎的中间，并且冲着杨童摆了一个起手式。

“你要干什么？”

杨童有些奇怪的看着眼前这个白白净净的小家伙。

“你又是谁？”

来人正是阡陌，阡陌昂着脑袋。

“这是我师父！不，是我大哥，我本来想要拜师的，但是大哥不收，不管怎么说，我在跟着胡大哥学习，就跟我师父一样！你们要是想要随意带走他，这是绝对不可能的……”

杨童眉头一皱，觉得这家伙跟着精神小伙一样，神神叨叨啰里啰嗦，她暗中微微用劲，阡陌只觉得浑身一个哆嗦，杨童反手一绕，已然是抓住胡九郎的手腕。

胡九郎也是急切道：

“好了，我跟你走，别动手！”

阡陌浑身都觉得不对劲，几乎站不稳了，此刻却一把抓住胡九郎的另一只胳膊。

“不准带走胡大哥！”

胡九郎担心这杨童还要动手，正要说话，杨童却道：

“一起走吧！”

杨童也不知道哪里来的力气，硬拉着胡九郎和阡陌出了巷口，胡九郎还喊道：

“门，我还没关门呢！”

杨童也是毫不在意的说道：

Yang Tong arrived at Hu Jiulang's side bravely.

Before Hu Jiulang could speak, Xixi said:

"What's going on? Mr. Hu, do you need help?"

This Xixi is really warm-hearted, Hu Jiulang smiled slightly.

"Sister, it's okay. You can go back first. I have other business!"

Xixi was relieved now, but she still couldn't help but said:

"Sir, please don't use this tone, right? Shouldn't you be polite?"

Xixi said as she walked out of the alley, got into her car, and left Juechen.

Hu Jiulang smiled bitterly.

"Ms. Yang, I am innocent, why should I go with you? I admit that I am a little greedy, but I really don't know what Mo Qiwei committed!"

Yang Tong hesitated and tried to pull Hu Jiulang's wrist. Hu Jiulang also took a step back. At this time, a young man rushed over, stood between Yang Tong and Hu Jiulang, and made a starting gesture towards Yang Tong.

"What are you going to do?"

Yang Tong looked at the fair little guy in front of him strangely.

"Who are you?"

The person who came was none other than Qian Mo, and Qian Mo held his head high.

"This is my master! No, it's my eldest brother. I originally wanted to become my disciple, but my eldest brother wouldn't accept it. Anyway, I'm studying with Brother Hu, just like my master! If you want to take him away at will, it's absolutely impossible..."

Yang Tong frowned, feeling that this guy was just like a spirited young man who was chattering away. She secretly exerted a little force, and Qian Mo felt a shiver all over her body. Yang Tong reached around and grabbed Hu Jiulang's wrist.

Hu Jiulang also said eagerly:

"Okay, I'll go with you, don't do anything!"

Qian Mo felt something was wrong all over and could hardly stand still. At this moment, he grabbed Hu Jiulang's other arm.

"Don't take Brother Hu away!"

Hu Jiulang was worried that Yang Tong would take action again, and when he was about to speak, Yang Tong said:

"Let's go together!"

Yang Tong didn't know where he got the strength to pull Hu Jiulang and Qian Mo out of the alley. Hu Jiulang even shouted:

"Door, I haven't closed it yet!"
